expectedSkipped is a property of (project x CHECKOUT), not of the project. EffectInferrerCorpusDepthTests skips without the corpus submodules, so the shard that feeds check_trx.py in .github/workflows/test.yml:375 (matrix name 'enforcement', submodules: false) sees 1 skip, while .github/workflows/publish-nuget.yml:72 checks out submodules: recursive for EVERY shard and sees 0. The pin said 'if that shard ever gains submodules this pin breaks loudly - which is the intended failure mode', and it did exactly that: it blocked the v0.16.0 publish (run 33568423848, executed 640 expected 639, all 640 PASSING). It was right to break, and the bug was applying one number to two checkouts.
